==Usage==
''For Parts 1-3'':<br />
<code><nowiki>{{LRMDate|#|subject}}</nowiki></code>

''For Prologue/Epilogue'':<br />
<code><nowiki>{{LRMDate|Prologue|subject}}</nowiki></code><br />
<code><nowiki>{{LRMDate|Epilogue|subject}}</nowiki></code>
